title: MapsData Google Maps lead scraping service pricing promo
summary: MapsData promo offering live Google Maps lead scraping at roughly thirty-three cents to ninety-eight cents per thousand leads, up to one hundred thousand leads per scrape, billing only for verified emails with five hundred free leads to start.
question_it_answers: What Maps scraping service pricing and volume caps were advertised for outbound lead lists?

claims.text: MapsData advertises pricing between thirty-three and ninety-eight cents per thousand leads with up to one hundred thousand leads per scrape.
claims.subject: outbound-gtm-agents

claims.text: Customers are billed only for emails and can start with five hundred free leads.

claims.text: mapsdata.ai **55,354 B** / pricing **46,936 B**. Title Google Maps Scraper with Verified Emails. First-party monthly: Starter **$19** / **$1.90 per 1,000** / 10k leads / 10k per search; Pro **$49** / **$0.98 per 1,000** / 50k / 50k per search; Scale **$99** / **$0.33 per 1,000** / 300k / **100,000 per search**. Annual SAVE 20%: $15 / $39 / $79 ($1.50 / $0.78 / $0.26 per 1k). Hero “as low as $3.30 per 10,000” is Scale annual math. **500 free leads a month** (refills; no card). Allowance counts only leads with an email. Tweet $0.33–$0.98 is Scale monthly + Pro monthly, not a single plan. US/CA/UK/AU. Product of Hiive Arts.
claims.subject: outbound-gtm-agents
